question: Which of the following Committees is associated with the ‘Ecology of Western Ghats’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gadgil Committee.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gadgil Committee is an environmental research committee is named after its **chairman Madhav Gadgil.**
 
• The** Panel** is** headed** by **Madhav Gadgil**, **formerly** with the** Indian Institute of Sciences, Bangalore.**
 
• The **expert panel set up in 2010 suggests a Western Ghats Ecology Authority (WGEA) **constitution, as a statutory authority appointed by the Ministry of Environment and Forests, with the powers under Section 3 of the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986.
 
• The **commission submitted the report** to the **Government of India** on **31 August 2011**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The Western Ghats have been identified as an extensive region, spanning more than six states, 44 districts, and 142 talukas. 
 
• Gadgil report recommended that “no new dams based on large-scale storage be permitted in Ecologically Sensitive Zone 1. 
 
• Ecologically Sensitive Zones (ESZ-1) was of high priority; almost all developmental activities (mining, thermal power plants, etc.) were restricted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Sarkaria Committee: **

 
 
• ​The **Sarkaria Commission’s charter **was to examine the relationship and** balance of power between central-state governments** in the country and suggest changes within the** framework of the Constitution of India**. 
 
 
 
• **Khan Committee:**
 
 
• SEBI had constituted a working group on March 26, 2018 under the Chairmanship of Shri H.R. Khan, Deputy Governor (Retired), Reserve Bank of India with the following terms of reference:-​​
 
 
• To advise **SEBI on redrafting the SEBI (Foreign Portfolio Investors) Regulations**, 2014 for simplification.
 
• To advise on any** other issue relevant to FPIs. **
 
 
 
 
 
• **​Mishra Committee:****​**
 
 
• **​Ranganath Mishra Commission **was constituted by the Govt of India on 29 October 2004 for Religious and Linguistic Minorities.
